def.en: A line that keeps you feeling safe and comfortable. You decide who can hug you, touch you or use your things.
def.hg: Ek line jo tumhe safe aur comfortable rakhti hai. Tumhe kaun hug kar sakta hai, touch kar sakta hai ya tumhari cheezein use kar sakta hai, yeh tum decide karte ho.

def.en: A grown-up who listens to you, believes you and helps you stay safe, like a parent, a grandparent or a teacher.
def.hg: Aisa bada jo tumhari baat sunta hai, tumpe believe karta hai aur tumhe safe rehne mein help karta hai, jaise parents, dada-dadi ya teacher.

def.en: Treating other people's bodies, feelings, things and choices as important, even when they are different from yours.
def.hg: Doosron ki body, feelings, cheezon aur choices ko important maanna, tab bhi jab woh tumhare se alag hon.

def.en: Trying to understand how another person feels, as if you were standing in their place.
def.hg: Yeh samajhne ki koshish karna ki doosra insaan kaisa feel kar raha hai, jaise tum uski jagah khade ho.

def.en: A way of speaking that starts with 'I feel' and explains your feeling instead of blaming the other person.
def.hg: Bolne ka ek tareeka jo 'mujhe feel hota hai' se shuru hota hai aur saamne wale ko blame karne ki jagah tumhari feeling batata hai.

def.en: When friends or classmates push you to do something so that you fit in, even if you do not want to.
def.hg: Jab dost ya classmates tumpe kuch karne ka zor daalte hain taaki tum fit in ho jao, bhale hi tumhara mann na ho.

def.en: Stating your needs and limits clearly and calmly, without attacking the other person and without giving up your own position.
def.hg: Apni needs aur limits clearly aur calmly bolna, saamne wale pe attack kiye bina aur apni position chhode bina.

def.en: Influencing someone through guilt, pressure, lies or flattery instead of honest asking, so that they act against their own wishes.
def.hg: Honestly poochne ki jagah guilt, pressure, jhooth ya flattery se kisi ko influence karna, taaki woh apni marzi ke against kaam kare.

def.en: Repeatedly denying or twisting facts so that another person starts doubting their own memory, feelings or judgement.
def.hg: Baar-baar facts ko deny ya twist karna taaki doosra insaan apni hi memory, feelings ya judgement pe doubt karne lage.

def.en: Checking who is making a claim, what the evidence is and what they gain, before you believe or share it.
def.hg: Kisi claim pe believe karne ya share karne se pehle check karna ki use kaun bol raha hai, evidence kya hai aur bolne wale ka isme kya fayda hai.

def.en: False or misleading information that spreads, whether or not the person sharing it knows it is wrong.
def.hg: Jhoothi ya misleading information jo phailti hai, chahe share karne wale ko pata ho ya na ho ki woh galat hai.

def.en: The duty of a doctor or counsellor to keep your personal information private, within limits set by law and safety.
def.hg: Doctor ya counsellor ki duty ki woh tumhari personal information private rakhein, law aur safety ki set ki hui limits ke andar.
